perche: ENTRY Z-C21.8, finding N22. taglia_membri read its end condition from the table of corner treatments of the member group, and a word that was not in that table fell back to swEndConditionTrim in silence: a misspelt condition cut the bars, the step succeeded, and the answer did not say which condition it had used. The same table holds the word for no corner treatment of a member group: the catalogue does not offer it for this operation, the trim/extend of SOLIDWORKS has no corner type for none, and the Z-C21.3 trim probe of 28/9/2026 measured end conditions 1, 2, 3 and 4, never 0. The library now takes the four words of the catalogue, whatever their case, refuses any other word, that one included, before touching the part, and writes the condition it used in the answer (end_condition).
il_difetto_che_questo_caso_prende: Step 3 asks for an end condition that does not exist: it must be refused. On library 0.144.0 it falls back to Trim, the short bar is cut by 40 mm and the step succeeds: red. Step 4 asks for the word for none, which 0.144.0 passed to InsertWeldmentTrimFeature2 as swEndConditionNone, a value nobody measured. Step 5 is the twin: the same two bars and the same cut with the default condition written out, and it gives the cut of il_taglio_accorcia_la_barra.
i_numeri: The scene of il_taglio_accorcia_la_barra without its far bar: bar (1) (0,0,0)-(600,0,0) and bar (2) (300,0,0)-(300,0,300) of the 80X80X5 square tube, the short one starting on the axis of the long one, so it enters it by half its width, 40 mm. There the cut of the short bar against the long one measured -58798.23 mm3 (40 mm x 1469.956 mm2); the far bar touched neither of them and was not among the bodies of that cut.
i_corpi_si_chiamano_per_nome: As in il_taglio_accorcia_la_barra: (1) the long bar, (2) the short one, in the order they are made.
